description: Fix the verified WhatsApp incident in transcript ff01b6b0-b584-41e0-8bed-92efcdf973a0: a second authorized group participant must receive and redeem an attachment handle while original uploader provenance remains unchanged. CommunicationMedia author matching currently denies that participant despite canonical history read access. Implementation adds confidential Engine authorization for exact stored attachment membership in a Shared transcript and current persisted-Person read access, used at both hydration and redemption. Direct and Replicated transcripts do not qualify. Three production files: CommunicationMedia, Engine.Api, TranscriptHistory. Existing group, private-access and MIME regression tests must remain untouched. New authorization tests cover revocation, outsiders, invalid identities, numeric-string connector IDs and source substitutions. Action reuse: extend current materialization authorization, reuse authorized TranscriptHistory.list and existing permissions; local-only authorization helper and Engine boundary, no new Action/tool exposure. Backend integration/property coverage makes new browser E2E unnecessary. Child plan: zaq-3yb.1 -> zaq-3yb.2. Current validation: mix q and focused 10 properties/145 tests pass; final precommit in progress. Changes remain uncommitted pending authorized landing.
